description: This file defines the PHP class Opencart.Catalog.Model.Tool.Upload, which provides methods for handling file upload operations within the OpenCart platform, including adding an upload record and retrieving an upload by its code.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: A model class for managing upload records, including creating and retrieving upload information.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Adds a new upload record to the database with the given name and filename, generating a unique code for the upload.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an upload record from the database by its unique code.
